name: SureNano Science Ltd.
summary: SureNano Science Ltd., founded in 2021 and headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, operates as a nanotechnology supplier with reach into Colorado, USA. The company's primary offering is SureNano surfactant, a ready-to-mix, food-grade compound that serves as the essential base for producing high-performance hemp and cannabis nano-emulsions. This versatile SureNano surfactant finds application across a wide array of products, including CBD goods, hemp-infused sprays, various beverages, edibles, and topical formulations.
